native_mechanisms: A single rolling sphere is the sole carried memory across the whole ordered pile (one accumulator, no side state, old state discarded each step).
A fixed count of tumbles/stalks per mark mixes each mark into the sphere before the next mark is taken.
Only the final hairline crack in the last stalk is kept as the token; all intermediate cracks and dust are discarded.
core_technique: xxHash-style block hash: four parallel 64-bit lanes absorbing 32-byte stripes through a fixed number of ARX (add-rotate-xor) rounds with cross-lane pairing, then cross-fold merge, byte-tail loop, and a SplitMix64 multiply-xor-shift finalizer.
